## GET /v1/tripadvisor/attraction - 1 credit (standard)

Returns a unified Place for one TripAdvisor attraction: name, editorial description, star rating, total review count, full address, phone, coordinates, opening hours, its rank within the destination, and its photo gallery. Get the `url_path` from /v1/tripadvisor/attractions or /v1/tripadvisor/search.

**Use when** Use it after attractions or search when you need the write-up, hours, or exact location.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url_path` (required) - The TripAdvisor `url_path` of the attraction, or a full TripAdvisor attraction URL. · e.g. `Attraction_Review-g60763-d105127-Reviews-Central_Park-New_York_City_New_York.html`
- `language` (optional, string) - Optional locale for the response, e.g. 'en_US'.
- `currency` (optional, string) - Optional 3-letter currency code for price fields, e.g. 'USD'.

**Response** `Place` object at `data`, `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/Place.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.category` | Primary category… |
| `place.price_level` | Price band ("inexpensive" / "$$" / null) |
| `place.reviews_count` | Number of ratings |
| `place.verified` | Claimed-business flag (Google is_claimed) |

+6 more fields in the full schema.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/attraction" \
  --data-urlencode "url_path=Attraction_Review-g60763-d105127-Reviews-Central_Park-New_York_City_New_York.html" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tripadvisor/attraction/reviews - 1-5 credits (request-shaped)

Returns a unified ReviewList of visitor reviews for a TripAdvisor attraction, keyed by its `url_path` (`entity_id` on every review). Each review carries the star rating, full text, title, reviewer profile with contribution count, attached photos, helpful-vote count, and the publish date. Get the `url_path` from /v1/tripadvisor/attractions. Note this endpoint carries no owner/management responses and no per-review permalink - both exist only on hotel and restaurant reviews. An attraction with no reviews returns 404 (auto-refunded).

**Use when** Use it once attractions has given you a url_path. This endpoint carries no owner replies and no per-review link.
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 1 credit per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.
**Paging** single page - Upstream page size is 20; a deeper `depth` is served by an internal offset fan-out inside one request.

**Query params**

- `url_path` (required) - The TripAdvisor `url_path` of the attraction, or a full TripAdvisor attraction URL. · e.g. `Attraction_Review-g60763-d105127-Reviews-Central_Park-New_York_City_New_York.html`
- `depth` (optional, integer) - Number of reviews to retrieve (default 20, max 40). · e.g. `20`
- `language` (optional, string) - Review language code, e.g. 'en'.
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality)

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `computed.labels_evidence` | When 1, every labelled row also carries… (with `label_evidence=1`) |
| `review.entity_id` | ID of the reviewed entity… |
| `review.helpful_votes` | Helpful-vote count (Amazon; null elsewhere) |

+14 more fields in the full schema. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tripadvisor/attraction/reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "url_path=Attraction_Review-g60763-d105127-Reviews-Central_Park-New_York_City_New_York.html" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tripadvisor/attractions - 1 credit (standard)

Returns a unified PlaceList carrying the star rating, review count, a photo, and the `url_path` you pass to /v1/tripadvisor/attraction or /v1/tripadvisor/attraction/reviews.

- `skip_the_line` (optional, boolean) - Only return skip-the-line activities.

## GET /v1/tripadvisor/autocomplete - 1 credit (standard)

Type-ahead lookup for TripAdvisor destinations, hotels, restaurants, and attractions. Returns a unified PlaceList with the resolved location id, name, locality subtitle (e.g. 'Ile-de-France, France'), coordinates, thumbnail, and the TripAdvisor URL to chain into /v1/tripadvisor/place or /v1/tripadvisor/reviews. Best for turning a name a user typed into a concrete place. Note this endpoint carries NO star rating and NO review count - use /v1/tripadvisor/search when you need those on every result.


## GET /v1/tripadvisor/place - 1 credit (standard)

Resolves any TripAdvisor place URL - hotel, restaurant, or attraction - into a unified Place: name, category, star rating, total review count, price level, address, phone, coordinates, and images. This is the generic resolver: pass the `url_path` from a /v1/tripadvisor/search result, or any TripAdvisor page URL a user pasted, and get back the resolved place. Use it to confirm which property a `url_path` actually points at before pulling its reviews, because TripAdvisor keys on the numeric id in the path and ignores the slug text, so a stale slug can name a different property than the one it resolves to. A URL that resolves to nothing returns 404 (auto-refunded).

**Use when** you want to confirm which property a url_path actually points at, since TripAdvisor keys on the numeric id and ignores the slug text.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.

## GET /v1/tripadvisor/search - 1 credit (standard)

Searches TripAdvisor for businesses and places (restaurants, hotels, attractions) matching a keyword in a location. Returns a unified PlaceList: each result carries the place name, category, star rating, total review count, and the `url_path` (the `id`/`url` are derived from it) that you pass to /v1/tripadvisor/reviews to pull that place's reviews. Results are location-bound (default: United States). Read from a task-based upstream; the async lifecycle is handled server-side, so this is an ordinary synchronous request (first calls take ~15-45s, then serve from cache).

- `language` (optional, string) - Optional language code to narrow results, e.g. 'en'.
- `depth` (optional, integer) - Number of results to retrieve (multiples of 30, default 30, max 60 on this synchronous endpoint).
